name: inboxapp
description: Message contacts and manage conversations across X and LinkedIn.

interface.longDescription:
Inboxapp lets you message contacts and manage conversations across X and LinkedIn.

Connect your X and LinkedIn accounts to handle your social conversations from one place, making it easier to stay in touch with the people who matter to you.

Use Inboxapp to:
- Message contacts on X and LinkedIn.
- Triage your inbox: see who is waiting on a reply and which conversations need attention first.
- Stay on top of follow-ups and spot conversations that have gone cold.
- Search past conversations and catch up on any contact before you reach out.
- Organize contacts with tags, statuses, and notes.

Support for Gmail, Instagram, WhatsApp, Telegram, and more platforms is on the way.

Whether you’re reaching out for the first time or continuing a conversation, Inboxapp helps you keep everyday communication organized and spend less time switching between apps.
